rule: Cache each eligible case's waiting count by the existing row-version stamp. Read intake metadata only for changed cases or uncached page rows; build and retain full summaries only for the visible page. Count waiting > 0 independently of search, status and pagination; prune cases excluded by the existing work CTE.
additionalFix: The list CTE scanned sources for every case before pagination. Move sourceCount and tableSourceIds to the page projection; preserve their values and ordering.

measurement.fixture: Existing isolated PGlite protocol schema: 21 cases/1 intake item and 200 cases/200 items, 20-row page, one off-page waiting case. No runtime or originals opened.
measurement.method: One discarded warm-up, then five cold-cache first polls, unchanged repeats and one-case changes. Reset only the in-process cache by replacing the isolated pool wrapper. Baseline loads work-queue.ts from 8454b17d in scratch and uses the identical sampler. Timings exclude fixture setup and EXPLAIN; first means cold application cache, not cold database.
measurement.units: Milliseconds; statements and returnedRows cover the whole poll. metadataCases counts case inputs to the intake metadata query, not full summaries. EXPLAIN relationRowsVisited is approximate (rounded per-loop PostgreSQL counters), not physical I/O.
measurement.boundedComparison: Count/page caching alone initially measured 21.515 ms at 200 cases. Hypothesis: pre-pagination source scans dominate. Compare only moving source display reads to the page; success <15 ms median, stop after five samples. Result 14.644 ms; final identical three-phase sampler measured 7.418 ms. Repeat EXPLAIN relation rows visited fell from 81600 to 9000.
measurement.limit: Stamps still scan identities/versions across eligible cases, and the list query still covers the register. Only intake metadata/projection work is changed-case bounded; no claim of constant total database work or production-runtime latency. Host timing varies.

tests: All five intake steps, each pending-kind fixture, evidence confirmations and invalidation, package 101 confirmation, commit queued/failed/committed, every existing stamp dependency, pagination/search/status, unchanged repeat without metadata, one off-page change, archived and dataset exclusion, overlapping polls and pool replacement.
inputs: Captured public-file manifest docs/evidence/gf1/lq1a/controls-second.json; existing 101-part and scaled case protocol records. No new real-file ingestion in this no-runtime task.
